result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but there are a few visual layout and data presentation concerns.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' section header alignment is slightly inconsistent with the 'Fastest near you' section header due to the large banner container.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the padding/margins for section headers across the main scrollable view.

issues.description: The bottom card showing a pizza has a '-100%' badge, but no restaurant name, delivery time, or rating associated with it, unlike the card above it.
issues.suggestion: Ensure all restaurant cards follow a consistent information structure, including store name and metadata, to avoid empty-looking cards.
